title: judgment-backend
objective: The judgment model behind the ST server plugin: reachable with a key, off by default, deciding speaker direction when opted in, falling back to today's chain on a timeout, recorded in its own ring, and never leaking the key.

checks.goal: the server plugin answers /status with a configured key, and reports where the key came from without the key itself

steps.eval: const headers = SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders(); const response = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers }).catch(() => null); if (!response) throw new Error('no response from the judge plugin route'); if (response.status === 404) throw new Error('judge plugin not loaded: install it with npm run plugin:install and start ST with enableServerPlugins: true'); const body = await response.json(); globalThis.__soJ11PluginStatus = body; if (!body.configured) throw new Error(`plugin loaded but no key: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`); if (JSON.stringify(body).length > 200) throw new Error('status body unexpectedly large'); return body;

checks.goal: judge off (the default): a real group turn is decided by today's chain and nothing reaches the plugin

steps.eval: const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (settings.enabled || Object.values(settings.uses).some(Boolean)) throw new Error(`judge not off by default: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setTalkDirectionEnabled(true); globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls = 0; if (!globalThis.__soJ11FetchWrapped) { const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = (input, init) => { if (String(input?.url ?? input).includes('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/systemone')) globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls += 1; return original(input, init); }; globalThis.__soJ11FetchWrapped = true; } return settings;

checks.goal: memoryVerify on (opt-in): a real read's memory lines are judged against the transcript before they are stored; every read with lines leaves a memoryVerify record, stored confidences follow policy

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 1500, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, memoryVerify: true } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); globalThis.__soJ11Mem = { judgeCalls: rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryVerify')).length, entryIds: snap.memory.entries.map((entry) => entry.id), drops: snap.memory.verifyDrops.length }; return globalThis.__soJ11Mem.entryIds.length;

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const base = globalThis.__soJ11Mem; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const added = snap.memory.entries.filter((entry) => !base.entryIds.includes(entry.id)); const drops = snap.memory.verifyDrops.slice(base.drops); const calls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryVerify')).slice(base.judgeCalls); const lines = added.length + drops.length; if (!lines) return { branch: 'the read produced no memory lines this time; nothing to verify', calls: calls.length }; if (!calls.length) throw new Error(`${lines} new memory lines but no memoryVerify record`); if (calls.every((event) => event.summary.includes('fell back'))) throw new Error(`every memoryVerify call fell back: ${calls.map((event) => event.summary).join(' | ')}`); const bad = added.filter((entry) => typeof entry.confidence === 'number' && (entry.confidence > 1 || entry.confidence < 0.2)); if (bad.length) throw new Error(`stored confidence outside policy: ${JSON.stringify(bad.map((entry) => [entry.text, entry.confidence]))}`); const badDrops = drops.filter((drop) => !(drop.p < 0.2) || drop.model !== 'jev-1.13.0'); if (badDrops.length) throw new Error(`drop outside policy: ${JSON.stringify(badDrops)}`); return { branch: drops.length ? 'some lines dropped as unsupported' : 'every line supported', stored: added.map((entry) => [entry.text, entry.confidence ?? 1]), drops: drops.map((drop) => [drop.entry.text, drop.p]), calls: calls.map((event) => event.summary) };
